gb.description: Abdul El-Sayed has become the United States' first Muslim Senator, storming to victory in Michigan as the Democrats' blue tsunami swept across America. The former health official, who ran on an explicitly progressive platform, defeated Republican candidate Mike Rogers in one of the most contentious races in this year's midterm elections. Dr El-Sayed declared victory in the early hours of Wednesday morning, addressing jubilant supporters at a rally in Detroit. The bitterly-fought campaign saw Donald Trump brand him a "jihadist", while Republican Congressman Ted Cruz accused him of being "a passionate supporter of the Muslim Brotherhood", warning Americans "will die" if he were to be elected. In his victory speech, Dr El-Sayed took a swipe at his critics as told supporters: "We did it!" "To President Trump, I know you struggle with my name. So after [Vice President] JD swears me in, you can just call me Senator," he said. The Democrat accused his opponents of weaponising his faith and identity to shy away from America's economic woes, including petrol prices and the cost of groceries. “They want an America that is too small for some of us,” Dr El-Sayed said. “We know that America is big enough for all of us.” More to follow...

es.title: Sevilla supera por primera vez los 870.000 afiliados en octubre
es.description: Sevilla ha marcado un récord de afiliación en octubre al superar los 870.000 altas en la Seguridad Social, concretamente ha registrado 870.436, que son 15.502 más que en septiembre y 28.323 más que hace justo un año . Así lo recoge el balance que ha distribuido este miércoles el Ministerio de Inclusión. La provincia aporta un tercio de los nuevos cotizantes que se han sumado al sistema en este último mes. Este incremento ha venido tanto por el régimen general como por el de autónomos. Esta importante subida de la afiliación no ha tenido un marcado impacto en las cifras del paro, que descienden en apenas 405 personas, apenas un 0,31%. Sin embargo, a pesar de lo modesta que es la cifra, la lectura es más que positiva, pues se trata de uno de los dos únicos territorios en la región donde baja el desempleo. Sevilla ha logrado desmarcarse de la tendencia negativa que ha azotado al conjunto de España . Mientras que a nivel nacional el número de desempleados registrados en las oficinas de los servicios públicos de empleo ha experimentado un incremento de 43.128 personas —un 1,81% más respecto a septiembre—, la provincia sevillana ha resistido el embate. Este dato, que coloca a Sevilla como una de las tres provincias españolas donde el desempleo ha descendido, ofrece un respiro en un contexto nacional marcado por la estacionalidad y el fin de los contratos vinculados al verano. Si se echa la vista atrás un año, el mercado laboral está mucho mejor, con 14.340 demandantes menos (-9,82%).Esta caída del paro se debe al empuje de todos los sectores, empezando por los servicios, que son el auténtico motor económico de la provincia y que recortaron su desempleo en 698 personas. A distancia se queda la construcción, con 91 parados menos y la industria y la agricultura, que recortan la lista en 31 y 32, respectivamente. Sólo el colectivo de personas sin experiencial laboral aumenta la cifra en 447 personas. Respecto a los contratos, en octubre se firmaron un total de 76.813 en Sevilla, que son 2.263 menos que en septiembre y 454 menos que hace un año. De ellos, sólo 29.438 fueron de carácter indefinido.

pl.title: Głośno w Barcelonie po popisie gwiazdy. W jednym szeregu z Lewandowskim

mx.title: Microsoft alerta de falsos instaladores de juegos y software que secuestran PCs con Windows
mx.description: Microsoft ha destapado una campaña de falsos instaladores que camufla malware bajo nombres de videojuegos, cracks y utilidades populares para colarse en equipos con Windows. Bajo una sola descarga, el sistema reparte varias ofertas de software que convierten el ancho de banda y la capacidad de cómputo de la víctima en ingresos, sin consentimiento informado. La investigación de Microsoft, publicada el 3 de noviembre, confirma tres ramas activas: el proxyware WorldProxyPool, la computación distribuida de CharityEngine y BOINC, y las utilidades de Advanced Windows Manager. Son programas con usos legítimos en otros contextos, pero aquí llegan sin que el usuario los autorice. ¿Qué señuelos usan los atacantes para camuflar el malware? El reclamo apunta a quien busca un atajo para no pagar: cracks de software comercial, plugins de audio, descargas de videojuegos, ejecutores de Roblox, autoclickers y herramientas para desbloquear terminales móviles. La campaña se dirige precisamente a este tipo de búsquedas, las que llevan a sitios de descarga no oficiales en busca de contenido gratuito que normalmente exige pago o licencia. Echo Client FabFilter Total Bundle Navicat Premium crack Deadpool Apunka Games Command & Conquer: Red Alert 2 TFT Unlock Tool El listado de señuelos detectados mezcla juegos clásicos, como el propio Command & Conquer: Red Alert 2, con utilidades profesionales de audio como FabFilter Total Bundle o herramientas de gestión de bases de datos como Navicat Premium. Esa variedad muestra que el reclamo no se limita a un tipo concreto de software: cualquier programa con demanda sirve de gancho si consigue que alguien ejecute el instalador. Microsoft no ha detallado más patrones entre las víctimas, más allá del tipo de búsqueda que las lleva hasta el instalador. Así se ejecuta el malware nada más abrir el instalador Todo arranca con un envoltorio al estilo Inno Setup que crea un ejecutable temporal dentro de %TEMP%is-*.tmp. Desde ahí se lanzan archivos numerados, como eld0.exe, eld3.exe o eld4.exe, identificados por los argumentos /SL5, /SPAWNWND y /FIRSTWND. El número de etapas varía de una sesión a otra: una instalación de Echo Client llegó a desencadenar varias ramas de monetización a partir de una sola descarga. Esos ejecutables temporales contactan con dominios que rotan constantemente mediante peticiones HTTP con los parámetros d=inno y r=offer_execution, junto con valores de sesión, afiliado y oferta que coordinan la entrega y registran el resultado. Si la instalación falla, el parámetro cambia a r=offer_execution_fail, a veces junto con avisos del antivirus. Cada oferta funciona de forma independiente: bloquear una no frena necesariamente las siguientes, y algunos payloads hijo se ejecutan antes o en paralelo a estas llamadas, por lo que la detección por comportamiento resulta más eficaz que bloquear dominios concretos. Tres ramas con un mismo objetivo: proxyware, cómputo distribuido y utilidades Cada rama deja un rastro distinto en el sistema, aunque todas recurren a interruptores de instalación silenciosa como /qn, /S, /quiet y /norestart para que no veas ninguna ventana durante el proceso. WorldProxyPool convierte tu equipo en un nodo proxy: instala sus componentes en C:Program FilesWorldProxyPool y crea tres tareas programadas con privilegios de SYSTEM: un agente que arranca con Windows, un vigilante de acceso basado en PowerShell oculto que corre cada cinco minutos y un actualizador horario. El propio instalador pone en marcha el agente de inmediato. La rama de CharityEngine y BOINC instala boinc.exe, charityengine.exe, varios envoltorios de cómputo y VirtualBox. Microsoft no ha confirmado minado de criptomonedas en esta rama, aunque sí deja constancia de que el equipo pasa a formar parte de una red de cómputo distribuido sin que el usuario lo haya decidido.

ph.title: Upcoming regional insurance program to shield Philippine assets from disasters
ph.description: Philippine public assets and infrastructure could enjoy financial protection from a multi-year disaster risk insurance program that the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN)+3 region is preparing to implement, according to the Department of Finance (DOF). Finance Undersecretary Joven Z. Balbosa, together with Deputy Vice-Minister of International Affairs of the Japan Ministry of Finance Daisaku Kihara, co-chaired the Southeast Asia Disaster Risk Insurance Facility – Sovereign Asset and Fiscal Empowerment (SEADRIF-SAFE) high-level roundtable to advance the implementation of the proposed regional initiative to protect public assets and infrastructure against disaster and climate shocks. SAFE is an ASEAN+3 regional initiative under SEADRIF that provides multi-year disaster risk insurance and financial protection for public infrastructure against climate and disaster shocks. “As the Philippines is one of the world’s disaster-prone countries, the preparation of SAFE will help ensure that the country’s public assets and infrastructure are protected even after disasters strike,” the DOF said in a Nov. 4 statement. Balbosa, who heads the DOF’s International Finance Group (IFG), said the regional initiative offers an opportunity to strengthen the Philippines’ financial protection of public infrastructure, which can be carried out by “integrating multi-year disaster risk insurance into development partner-financed projects.” “This approach could also leverage regional risk pooling and improve access to international insurance and reinsurance markets, helping ensure more timely financial protection when disasters occur,” said Balbosa. According to the DOF, SAFE was endorsed at the ASEAN+3 finance ministers and central bank governors meeting in Uzbekistan in May 2026, paving the way for the development of its technical and implementation plans. Member countries expressed support for the initiative and its upcoming implementation, the DOF said. For the DOF, SAFE promises stronger financial protection and resilience for critical public infrastructure in the region. Additionally, member countries said the initiative should support existing national disaster financing programs and leverage the expertise of development finance institutions (DFIs). To identify pilot projects under the program, the DOF said “member countries agreed to consider its technical, financial, legal, and operational feasibility, while allowing flexibility for country-specific requirements.” For its part, the DOF committed to continuing the development of SAFE ahead of its planned operational launch, the date of which remains undisclosed. (Derco Rosal)

ae.title: UAE e-scooter rules: Permit mandatory for users aged 15 and above from January 2027
ae.description: Abu Dhabi: Users of e-scooters, electric bicycles and small bicycles in the UAE will be required to obtain permits under new executive regulations for the Traffic Law that take effect on January 1, 2027. Applicants must be at least 15-years old, with permits valid for three years and renewable. The regulations introduce three types of permits covering electric scooters, electric bicycles and small bicycles, as part of measures governing the use of personal means of transport on roads across the country. They also establish registration, technical and safety requirements and specify where personal transport devices can be used. Registration and permits Personal means of transport must be registered in accordance with procedures set by the relevant licensing authority or traffic control authority. Users will not be permitted to operate them without the required permit. The licensing authority will issue permits for personal means of transport, with applicants required to be at least 15-years old. Six categories of personal transport The regulations classify personal means of transport into six categories according to their specifications. These include conventional bicycles powered by the rider and not equipped with an automatic or hybrid motor, as well as electric bicycles fitted with a power unit that assists pedalling. Electric scooters powered by an electric motor and designed to be ridden while standing or sitting are also covered. Another category covers small bicycles fitted with an automatic or electric motor, with an engine capacity not exceeding 50cc and a maximum speed of 45 kilometres per hour. The regulations also cover skateboards designed for personal transport, whether powered by the user's movement or a motor, and mobility devices for elderly people and people with disabilities, including seats powered by a motor or propelled by the user. Safety requirements Personal means of transport must meet a series of technical and safety requirements before they can be used on designated routes. They must have a front light to illuminate the road at night and a rear red light connected to the brakes. An audible warning device must be fitted to the handlebars, while brakes must be installed on at least the rear wheel. Tyres must be securely fitted and roadworthy, and wheel cables must be complete and properly tightened. All components must also be durable and securely fitted to ensure safe use. Users must comply with any additional requirements introduced by the relevant licensing authority. Six obligations for users The regulations set six obligations aimed at protecting users, pedestrians and other road users. Personal means of transport must be registered with the relevant authority and cannot be used without the required permit. Users must not ride them on roads designated for motor vehicles. They must follow traffic rules and relevant guidance and operate their devices in a manner that does not endanger themselves, pedestrians or motorists. They must also use routes specified by the licensing or traffic control authority and comply with the designated speed limits. The prescribed safety requirements apply to privately owned devices as well as those provided for rent by commercial establishments. Traffic light rules The regulations also specify how traffic signals apply to pedestrians and users of personal means of transport. A red light prohibits them from crossing the road, while a green light allows them to cross. A flashing green light means users and pedestrians must not begin crossing. Those who have already started crossing during the permitted period may continue until they reach the other side. Four essential safety requirements Personal means of transport must have: A front light for nighttime use and a rear red light connected to the brakes. An audible warning device mounted on the handlebars. Brakes fitted to at least the rear wheel. Tyres that are securely fitted and roadworthy.

ae.title: Abdul El-Sayed becomes first Muslim elected to US Senate
ae.description: DETROIT: Democrat Abdul El-Sayed won Michigan’s open US Senate seat on Tuesday, according to media projections, becoming the first Muslim elected to the chamber while preserving a crucial Democratic seat in the party’s fight for Senate control. El-Sayed’s victory in the closely contested election marked a breakthrough for the Democratic Party’s progressive wing and denied Republicans a chance to flip the seat of retiring Democratic Senator Gary Peters. El-Sayed, 42, a former public health official, focused on lowering costs for working families and reducing corporate influence in politics. His platform included Medicare for All, a government-funded universal healthcare program championed by progressives in his party. Republicans held a 53-47 Senate majority going into Tuesday’s midterm elections, with Democrats needing a net gain of four seats to take control. His opponent Mike Rogers, 63, a former congressman and FBI agent, entered the race with strong backing from Trump and national Republicans and had sought to cast El-Sayed as a radical candidate sympathetic to Islamic extremism through alleged ties to the Muslim Brotherhood, claims that El-Sayed denies and that remain unsupported by evidence. Democrats said the attacks on El-Sayed relied on Islamophobic tropes. Rogers also devoted significant effort to courting Jewish voters who may have been uneasy with El-Sayed's opposition to US military aid for Israel and his characterization of Israel's actions in Gaza as genocide. But Rogers struggled to overcome voter concerns about the economy and Trump's low ratings. In the closing weeks of the race, he broke with the president on the war in Iran and the US trade dispute with Canada, arguing that ending both was necessary to help bring down costs for businesses and consumers.

za.description: The PS noted that the Ministry, through the Kenya National Examinations Council (KNEC), has provided transport for every school and therefore does not anticipate any challenges. "We may not have a lot of challenges this year," he said, entrusting the process to God and praying that all involved will be guided to do the right thing at all times. On the heavy rains and possible flooding, the PS said the National and County Governments, together with the Ministry of Education, have mapped out high-risk areas, and several committees are monitoring the situation. Additional containers will be provided where needed, and a helicopter will be deployed where necessary. The Ministry will also monitor the examinations in real time. By 9 or 10 a.m. each day, it receives a countrywide report confirming that examination materials have arrived and flagging any challenges. A second report follows in the evening, providing a quick way to identify and resolve any issue. The PS later visited Buruburu Girls Secondary School to witness the start of the first paper and wish the candidates success. Distributed by APO Group on behalf of Ministry of Education, Kenya.

za.title: Lived poverty remains stubbornly high in Africa, new Afrobarometer report shows
za.description: Lived poverty remains persistently high across African countries as majorities of citizens experience shortages of basic necessities such as food, clean water, and medical care, according to the latest Afrobarometer Pan-Africa Profile (https://apo-opa.co/4BEFFq9). Based on nationally representative surveys in 38 African countries, the analysis finds that moderate or high levels of lived poverty affect an average of six in 10 citizens, ranging up to more than eight in 10 in Chad and Gabon. After worsening steadily between 2014 and 2023, levels of lived poverty show no sign of improving in the latest survey round. Many respondents say they had to turn to informal support networks such as family, friends, and community organisations for assistance to make ends meet. The findings also reveal that lived poverty is associated with difficulties in accessing essential public services, including health care, police assistance, and government documentation. Meanwhile, individuals experiencing high levels of lived poverty are less likely to own a bank account, whereas mobile money is relatively accessible across the lived-poverty gradient. Key findings On average across 38 countries, eight in 10 citizens (79%) say they or a family member went without a cash income at least once during the preceding year, including 43% who did so “many times” or “always” (Figure 1). Two-thirds (65%) went without needed medicine or medical care, and majorities suffered shortages of clean water (57%), food (58%),[1] and cooking fuel (52%). Across 30 countries surveyed in both 2014/2015 and 2024/2025, the proportion of citizens experiencing moderate or high levels of lived poverty increased by 13 percentage points, from 47% to 60% (Figure 2). Rates of moderate/high lived poverty vary dramatically by country, ranging from 7% in Seychelles to 86% in Chad. Almost half (47%) of respondents say they had to seek assistance from family members during the previous year to make ends meet, while 33% sought help from friends or neighbours and 12% requested assistance from religious, community, or charitable groups (Figure 3). Poverty is compounded by reduced access to essential services. The poorest citizens are roughly twice as likely as the well-off to report that they found it difficult to obtain health care, a government identification document, and police assistance (Figure 4). Poor citizens are half as likely as their well-off counterparts to own a bank account (40% vs. 83%). But mobile-money account ownership is widespread and fairly consistent across income levels, at 69% among the poorest and 71% among the wealthiest (Figure 5). Afrobarometer surveys Afrobarometer is a pan-African, nonpartisan survey research network that provides reliable data on African experiences and evaluations of democracy, governance, and quality of life. Ten survey rounds in up to 45 countries have been completed since 1999. Round 10 surveys (2024/2025) cover 38 countries. Afrobarometer’s National Partners conduct face-to-face interviews in the language of the respondent’s choice that yield country-level results with margins of error of +/-2 to +/-3 percentage points at a 95% confidence level.
